title: VideoDetail
description: One video as its detail screen reads it.

created_at.description: Creation timestamp in UTC ISO-8601 form.

input_path.description: The source path the engine decodes.

order.description: Zero-based position in the project's queue.

output_exists.description: Whether the engine has produced a complete encode for this video.

output_path.description: Where the concatenated output is written.

retained_bytes.description: Bytes retained under this video's temporary directory, including scene chunks.
